pages.title: Scroll
pages.text:
Can store one spell and 256 mana.

$(l)Usage:$()
Hold in main hand and right-click to open spell editing interface, after editing Shift+right-click to infuse mana, when full a naming window pops up, name it and click confirm to seal

pages.title: Sealed Scroll
pages.text: Sealed scrolls cannot be modified, but you can still Shift+right-click to open spell viewing interface to see the structure of the sealed spell, or right-click to cast the spell if mana is sufficient, which consumes mana and durability

pages.title: Lapis Lazuli Scroll
pages.text:
Can store one spell and 512 mana.

$(l)Usage:$()
Same as Scroll

pages.title: Diamond Scroll
pages.text:
Can store one spell and 1024 mana, and spell casting consumes only 50% of original mana.

$(l)Usage:$()
Same as Scroll
